module Unimol2DataAdd2DConformerDataset
    using PyCall
    using Memoize
    using ..Main: AbstractBaseWrapperDataset

    const np = pyimport("numpy")
    const Chem = pyimport("rdkit.Chem")
    const AllChem = pyimport("rdkit.Chem.AllChem")

    export Add2DConformerDataset, smi2_2Dcoords

    mutable struct Add2DConformerDataset <: AbstractBaseWrapperDataset
        dataset
        smi
        atoms
        coordinates
        epoch
    end

    function Add2DConformerDataset(dataset, smi, atoms, coordinates)
        instance = Add2DConformerDataset(dataset, smi, atoms, coordinates, nothing)
        set_epoch!(instance, nothing)
        return instance
    end

    function set_epoch!(self::Add2DConformerDataset, epoch; unused...)
        self.epoch = epoch
    end

    @memoize function __cached_item__(self::Add2DConformerDataset, index::Int, epoch)
        py_index = index - 1
        atoms = np.array(self.dataset[py_index][self.atoms])
        @assert length(atoms) > 0
        smi = self.dataset[py_index][self.smi]
        coordinates_2d = smi2_2Dcoords(smi)
        coordinates = self.dataset[py_index][self.coordinates]
        return Dict(
            "smi" => smi,
            "atoms" => atoms,
            "coordinates" => coordinates,
            "coordinates_2d" => coordinates_2d,
        )
    end

    function Base.getindex(self::Add2DConformerDataset, index::Int)
        return __cached_item__(self, index, self.epoch)
    end

    function smi2_2Dcoords(smi)
        mol = Chem.MolFromSmiles(smi)
        mol = AllChem.AddHs(mol)
        AllChem.Compute2DCoords(mol)
        coordinates = mol.GetConformer().GetPositions().astype(np.float32)
        @assert length(mol.GetAtoms()) == size(coordinates, 1) "2D coordinates shape is not align with $(smi)"
        return coordinates
    end
end

module Unimol2DataDataUtils
    using PyCall
    using Random

    const np = pyimport("numpy")

    export numpy_seed

    function numpy_seed(seed_val, addl_seeds...)
        if seed_val === nothing
            return
        end

        if !isempty(addl_seeds)
            seed_val = Int(hash((seed_val, addl_seeds...)) % 1_000_000)
        end
        
        state = np.random.get_state()
        np.random.seed(seed_val)
        
        try
            task_local_storage(:numpy_state, state)
        catch e
            rethrow(e)
        finally
            if haskey(task_local_storage(), :numpy_state)
                np.random.set_state(task_local_storage(:numpy_state))
            end
        end
    end
end

    end

        dd = copy(self.dataset[py_index])
        atoms = dd[self.atoms]
        coordinates = dd[self.coordinates]
        coordinates_2d = dd[self.coordinates_2d]

        if self.max_atoms !== nothing && length(atoms) > self.max_atoms
            numpy_seed(self.seed, epoch, py_index) do

                atoms = np.array(atoms)[rand_indices.+1] 
                coordinates = coordinates[rand_indices.+1, :]
                coordinates_2d = coordinates_2d[rand_indices.+1, :]

                dd[self.coordinates] = coordinates.astype(np.float32)
                dd[self.coordinates_2d] = coordinates_2d.astype(np.float32)
            end
        end
        return dd
    end

        return __cached_item__(self, index, self.epoch)
    end

module Unimol2DataGraphFeatures
    using PyCall
    using Memoize
    using Numba
    using PyTorch
    using ..Main: AbstractBaseWrapperDataset

    const np = pyimport("numpy")
    
    export floyd_warshall, ShortestPathDataset, DegreeDataset, collate_1d_features, AtomFeatDataset, collate_2d_features, BondDataset, convert_to_single_emb, PairTypeDataset

    @njit function floyd_warshall(M)
        (nrows, ncols) = size(M)
        @assert nrows == ncols
        n = nrows
        
        for i in 1:n
            for j in 1:n
                if M[i, j] == 0
                    M[i, j] = 510
                end
            end
        end
        
        for i in 1:n
            M[i, i] = 0
        end
        
        for k in 1:n
            for i in 1:n
                for j in 1:n
                    cost_ikkj = M[i, k] + M[k, j]
                    if M[i, j] > cost_ikkj
                        M[i, j] = cost_ikkj
                    end
                end
            end
        end
        
        for i in 1:n
            for j in 1:n
                if M[i, j] >= 510
                    M[i, j] = 510
                end
            end
        end
        return M
    end

    mutable struct ShortestPathDataset <: AbstractBaseWrapperDataset
        dataset
        has_bos::Bool
        has_eos::Bool
    end

    function ShortestPathDataset(dataset; has_bos=true, has_eos=true)
        return ShortestPathDataset(dataset, has_bos, has_eos)
    end

    @memoize function Base.getindex(self::ShortestPathDataset, idx::Int)
        py_idx = idx - 1
        data = self.dataset[py_idx]
        num_atoms = size(data["atoms"], 1)
        offset = 0
        if self.has_bos
            num_atoms += 1
            offset = 1
        end
        if self.has_eos
            num_atoms += 1
        end
        
        adj = fill(510, (num_atoms, num_atoms))
        
        edge_index = data["edge_index"]
        adj[edge_index[1, :] .+ offset .+ 1, edge_index[2, :] .+ offset .+ 1] .= 1
        
        shortest_path_result = floyd_warshall(adj)
        shortest_path_result[shortest_path_result .> 510] .= 510
        
        spatial_pos = PyTorch.from_numpy(shortest_path_result).long()
        return spatial_pos
    end

    mutable struct DegreeDataset <: AbstractBaseWrapperDataset
        dataset
        has_bos::Bool
        has_eos::Bool
    end

    function DegreeDataset(dataset; has_bos=true, has_eos=true)
        return DegreeDataset(dataset, has_bos, has_eos)
    end

    @memoize function Base.getindex(self::DegreeDataset, idx::Int)
        py_idx = idx - 1
        data = self.dataset[py_idx]
        num_atoms = size(data["atoms"], 1)
        offset = 0
        if self.has_bos
            num_atoms += 1
            offset = 1
        end
        if self.has_eos
            num_atoms += 1
        end
        
        adj = zeros(Int, num_atoms, num_atoms)
        edge_index = data["edge_index"]
        adj[edge_index[1, :] .+ offset .+ 1, edge_index[2, :] .+ offset .+ 1] .= 1
        
        degree = sum(adj, dims=2) .+ 1
        return PyTorch.from_numpy(degree).long()
    end

    function collate_1d_features(values, pad_idx; pad_to_multiple=1)
        v = values[1]
        size_val = maximum(v.size(0) for v in values)
        if pad_to_multiple != 1 && size_val % pad_to_multiple != 0
            size_val = Int(((size_val - 0.1) ÷ pad_to_multiple + 1) * pad_to_multiple)
        end
        res = values[1].new(length(values), size_val, size(v, -1)).fill_(pad_idx)
        
        function copy_tensor(src, dst)
            @assert dst.numel() == src.numel()
            dst.copy_(src)
        end
        
        for (i, v) in enumerate(values)
            copy_tensor(v, res[i, 1:size(v, 1), :])
        end
        
        return res
    end

    mutable struct AtomFeatDataset <: AbstractBaseWrapperDataset
        dataset
        num_features::Int
        num_vals::Int
        has_bos::Bool
        has_eos::Bool
        remove_hydrogen::Bool
        remove_polar_hydrogen::Bool
    end

    function AtomFeatDataset(dataset; num_features=8, num_vals=16, has_bos=true, has_eos=true, remove_hydrogen=false, remove_polar_hydrogen=false)
        return AtomFeatDataset(dataset, num_features, num_vals, has_bos, has_eos, remove_hydrogen, remove_polar_hydrogen)
    end

    @memoize function Base.getindex(self::AtomFeatDataset, idx::Int)
        py_idx = idx - 1
        data = self.dataset[py_idx]
        
        num_atoms = self.remove_hydrogen ? length(data["atoms_token"]) : length(data["atoms_h_token"])
        
        function check(orig_atoms, dst_atoms)
            mask_hydrogen = orig_atoms .!= "H"
            orig_atoms = orig_atoms[mask_hydrogen]
            @assert all(orig_atoms .== dst_atoms)
        end
        
        if size(data["atoms"]) != size(data["atoms_h_token"]) || !all(data["atoms"] .== data["atoms_h_token"])
            println("exception data...", data["smi"], data["atoms"], data["atoms_h_token"], data["atoms_token"])
            check(data["atoms"], data["atoms_token"])
        end
        
        offset = 0
        if self.has_bos
            num_atoms += 1
            offset = 1
        end
        if self.has_eos
            num_atoms += 1
        end

        feat = fill(1, (num_atoms, self.num_features))
        
        if !data["drop_feat"]
            node_attr = data["node_attr"]
            feat[offset+1 : offset+size(node_attr, 1), :] = node_attr[:, 2:end] .+ 3
        else
            node_attr = data["node_attr"]
            feat[offset+1 : offset+size(node_attr, 1), :] .= 2
        end

        for i in 1:self.num_features
            feat[:, i] .+= (i-1) * self.num_vals
        end
        
        return PyTorch.from_numpy(feat).long()
    end
    
    collater(self::AtomFeatDataset, samples) = collate_1d_features(samples, 0, pad_to_multiple=8)

    function collate_2d_features(values, pad_idx; pad_to_multiple=1)
        v = values[1]
        size_val = maximum(v.size(0) for v in values)
        if pad_to_multiple != 1 && size_val % pad_to_multiple != 0
            size_val = Int(((size_val - 0.1) ÷ pad_to_multiple + 1) * pad_to_multiple)
        end
        res = values[1].new(length(values), size_val, size_val, size(v, -1)).fill_(pad_idx)
        
        function copy_tensor(src, dst)
            @assert dst.numel() == src.numel()
            dst.copy_(src)
        end

        for (i, v) in enumerate(values)
            copy_tensor(v, res[i, 1:size(v, 1), 1:size(v, 2), :])
        end
        
        return res
    end
    
    mutable struct BondDataset <: AbstractBaseWrapperDataset
        dataset
        num_features::Int
        num_vals::Int
        has_bos::Bool
        has_eos::Bool
        remove_hydrogen::Bool
        remove_polar_hydrogen::Bool
    end

    function BondDataset(dataset; num_features=4, num_vals=8, has_bos=true, has_eos=true, remove_hydrogen=false, remove_polar_hydrogen=false)
        return BondDataset(dataset, num_features, num_vals, has_bos, has_eos, remove_hydrogen, remove_polar_hydrogen)
    end
    
    @memoize function Base.getindex(self::BondDataset, idx::Int)
        py_idx = idx - 1
        data = self.dataset[py_idx]
        
        num_atoms = self.remove_hydrogen ? length(data["atoms_token"]) : length(data["atoms_h_token"])
        
        offset = 0
        if self.has_bos
            num_atoms += 1
            offset = 1
        end
        if self.has_eos
            num_atoms += 1
        end

        edge_feat = fill(1, (num_atoms, num_atoms, self.num_features))
        
        if !data["drop_feat"]
            edge_index = data["edge_index"]
            edge_attr = data["edge_attr"]
            edge_feat[:, :, 1] .= 3
            for i in 1:num_atoms
                edge_feat[i, i, 1] = 4
            end
            edge_feat[edge_index[1, :].+offset.+1, edge_index[2, :].+offset.+1, 1] .= 5
            edge_feat[edge_index[1, :].+offset.+1, edge_index[2, :].+offset.+1, 2:end] = edge_attr .+ 3
        else
            edge_index = data["edge_index"]
            edge_attr = data["edge_attr"]
            edge_feat[edge_index[1, :].+offset.+1, edge_index[2, :].+offset.+1, :] .= 2
        end

        for i in 1:self.num_features
            edge_feat[:, :, i] .+= self.num_vals * (i-1)
        end
        
        return PyTorch.from_numpy(edge_feat).long()
    end
    
    collater(self::BondDataset, samples) = collate_2d_features(samples, 0, pad_to_multiple=8)

    function convert_to_single_emb(x, sizes)
        @assert size(x, -1) == length(sizes)
        offset = 1
        for i in 1:length(sizes)
            @assert all(x[.., i] .< sizes[i])
            x[.., i] = x[.., i] .+ offset
            offset += sizes[i]
        end
        return x
    end

    mutable struct PairTypeDataset <: AbstractBaseWrapperDataset
        dataset
        num_types::Int
    end
    
    function PairTypeDataset(dataset::PyTorch.Tensor, num_types::Int)
        return PairTypeDataset(dataset, num_types)
    end
    
    @memoize function Base.getindex(self::PairTypeDataset, index::Int)
        py_index = index - 1
        node_input = self.dataset[py_index].clone()
        N = length(node_input)
        pair_type = cat(
            node_input.view(-1, 1, 1).expand(-1, N, -1),
            node_input.view(1, -1, 1).expand(N, -1, -1),
            dims=-1
        )
        pair_type = convert_to_single_emb(pair_type, [128, 128])
        return pair_type
    end
    
    collater(self::PairTypeDataset, samples) = collate_2d_features(samples, 0, pad_to_multiple=8)
end

module Unimol2DataLMDBDataset
    using PyCall
    using Logging
    using Distributed
    
    const lmdb = pyimport("lmdb")
    const pickle = pyimport("pickle")
    const shutil = pyimport("shutil")
    const os = pyimport("os")
    const time = pyimport("time")
    
    export lmdb_data_copy_fun, LMDBDataset

    @Logging.configure(level=INFO)

    function lmdb_data_copy_fun(src_path_dir, target_path_dir, epoch, split)
        db_path_src = os.path.join(src_path_dir, "$(split)_part_$(epoch).lmdb")
        db_path_tgt = os.path.join(target_path_dir, "$(split)_part_$(epoch).lmdb")
        
        if os.path.exists(db_path_tgt)
            return
        end
        if !os.path.exists(db_path_src)
            @warn "please note that $(db_path_src) not exists."
            return
        end
        
        shutil.copyfile(db_path_src, db_path_tgt)
        
        last_db_path_tgt = os.path.join(target_path_dir, "$(split)_part_$(epoch-2).lmdb")
        if os.path.exists(last_db_path_tgt)
            rm(last_db_path_tgt)
        end
        
        @info "finished async copy file from $(db_path_src) to $(db_path_tgt)"
    end

    mutable struct LMDBDataset
        db_dir
        tmp_data_dir
        lmdb_copy_thread
        split
        max_epoch
        content
        _keys
        db_path_tgt
        db_path_tgt_lock
        db_path_src
    end

    function LMDBDataset(db_dir, split, epoch, max_epoch; lmdb_copy_thread=nothing, tmp_data_dir="/temp/")
        if !os.path.exists(tmp_data_dir)
            mkpath(tmp_data_dir)
        end
        
        instance = LMDBDataset(db_dir, tmp_data_dir, lmdb_copy_thread, split, max_epoch, nothing, nothing, nothing, nothing, nothing)
        instance.content = load_data!(instance, tmp_data_dir, epoch, split)
        return instance
    end

    function load_data!(self::LMDBDataset, data_dir, epoch, split)
        self.db_path_tgt = os.path.join(data_dir, "$(split)_part_$(epoch-1).lmdb")
        self.db_path_tgt_lock = os.path.join(data_dir, "$(split)_part_$(epoch-1).lmdb.lock")
        
        if !os.path.exists(self.db_path_tgt)
            self.db_path_src = os.path.join(self.db_dir, "$(split)_part_$(epoch-1).lmdb")
            if !os.path.exists(self.db_path_src)
                throw(FileNotFoundError("$(self.db_path_src) not found, please make sure the max-epoch were setting right."))
            end
            run(`touch $(self.db_path_tgt_lock)`)
            shutil.copyfile(self.db_path_src, self.db_path_tgt)
            @info "$(self.db_path_tgt) not exist, copy file from $(self.db_path_src)"
            run(`rm -rf $(self.db_path_tgt_lock)`)
        else
            while os.path.exists(self.db_path_tgt_lock)
                time.sleep(1)
            end
        end
        
        env = lmdb.open(
            self.db_path_tgt,
            subdir=false,
            readonly=true,
            lock=false,
            readahead=false,
            meminit=false,
            max_readers=256,
        )
        
        content = []
        txn = env.begin()
        self._keys = 1:txn.stat()["entries"]
        for idx in self._keys
            py_idx = idx - 1
            datapoint_pickled = txn.get(py_idx.to_bytes(4, byteorder="big"))
            push!(content, datapoint_pickled)
        end
        
        if self.lmdb_copy_thread !== nothing
            @async lmdb_data_copy_fun(self.db_dir, self.tmp_data_dir, epoch, self.split)
        end
        
        return content
    end

    Base.length(self::LMDBDataset) = length(self._keys)

    function set_epoch!(self::LMDBDataset, epoch)
        if epoch !== nothing && epoch < self.max_epoch
            self.content = load_data!(self, self.tmp_data_dir, epoch, self.split)
        end
    end

    @memoize function Base.getindex(self::LMDBDataset, idx::Int)
        datapoint_pickled = self.content[idx]
        data = pickle.loads(datapoint_pickled)
        return data
    end
end

    using ..Unimol2DataDataUtils: numpy_seed
    using ..Unimol2DataGraphFeatures: floyd_warshall, convert_to_single_emb

    const np = pyimport("numpy")
    const Chem = pyimport("rdkit.Chem")
    const AllChem = pyimport("rdkit.Chem.AllChem")
    const RDLogger = pyimport("rdkit.RDLogger")
    RDLogger.DisableLog("rdApp.*")
    
    export MoleculeFeatureDataset, pad_1d, pad_1d_feat, pad_2d, pad_2d_feat, pad_attn_bias, smi2_graph_features

    const allowable_features = Dict(
        "possible_atomic_num_list" => vcat(1:118, "misc"),
        "possible_chirality_list" => [
            "CHI_UNSPECIFIED", "CHI_TETRAHEDRAL_CW", "CHI_TETRAHEDRAL_CCW",
            "CHI_TRIGONALBIPYRAMIDAL", "CHI_OCTAHEDRAL", "CHI_SQUAREPLANAR", "CHI_OTHER"
        ],
        "possible_degree_list" => vcat(0:10, "misc"),
        "possible_formal_charge_list" => vcat(-5:5, "misc"),
        "possible_numH_list" => vcat(0:8, "misc"),
        "possible_number_radical_e_list" => vcat(0:4, "misc"),
        "possible_hybridization_list" => ["SP", "SP2", "SP3", "SP3D", "SP3D2", "misc"],
        "possible_is_aromatic_list" => [false, true],
        "possible_is_in_ring_list" => [false, true],
        "possible_bond_type_list" => ["SINGLE", "DOUBLE", "TRIPLE", "AROMATIC", "misc"],
        "possible_bond_stereo_list" => [
            "STEREONONE", "STEREOZ", "STEREOE", "STEREOCIS", "STEREOTRANS", "STEREOANY"
        ],
        "possible_is_conjugated_list" => [false, true],
    )

    function safe_index(l, e)
        try
            return findfirst(isequal(e), l) - 1
        catch
            return length(l) - 1
        end
    end

    function atom_to_feature_vector(atom)
        atom_feature = [
            safe_index(allowable_features["possible_atomic_num_list"], atom.GetAtomicNum()),
            findfirst(isequal(string(atom.GetChiralTag())), allowable_features["possible_chirality_list"]) - 1,
            safe_index(allowable_features["possible_degree_list"], atom.GetTotalDegree()),
            safe_index(allowable_features["possible_formal_charge_list"], atom.GetFormalCharge()),
            safe_index(allowable_features["possible_numH_list"], atom.GetTotalNumHs()),
            safe_index(allowable_features["possible_number_radical_e_list"], atom.GetNumRadicalElectrons()),
            safe_index(allowable_features["possible_hybridization_list"], string(atom.GetHybridization())),
            findfirst(isequal(atom.GetIsAromatic()), allowable_features["possible_is_aromatic_list"]) - 1,
            findfirst(isequal(atom.IsInRing()), allowable_features["possible_is_in_ring_list"]) - 1,
        ]
        return atom_feature
    end

    function bond_to_feature_vector(bond)
        bond_feature = [
            safe_index(allowable_features["possible_bond_type_list"], string(bond.GetBondType())),
            findfirst(isequal(string(bond.GetStereo())), allowable_features["possible_bond_stereo_list"]) - 1,
            findfirst(isequal(bond.GetIsConjugated()), allowable_features["possible_is_conjugated_list"]) - 1,
        ]
        return bond_feature
    end

    function get_graph(mol)
        atom_features_list = [atom_to_feature_vector(atom) for atom in mol.GetAtoms()]
        x = np.array(atom_features_list, dtype=np.int32)
        
        num_bond_features = 3
        if length(mol.GetBonds()) > 0
            edges_list = []
            edge_features_list = []
            for bond in mol.GetBonds()
                i = bond.GetBeginAtomIdx()
                j = bond.GetEndAtomIdx()
                edge_feature = bond_to_feature_vector(bond)
                push!(edges_list, (i, j))
                push!(edge_features_list, edge_feature)
                push!(edges_list, (j, i))
                push!(edge_features_list, edge_feature)
            end
            edge_index = np.array(edges_list, dtype=np.int32).T
            edge_attr = np.array(edge_features_list, dtype=np.int32)
        else
            edge_index = np.empty((2, 0), dtype=np.int32)
            edge_attr = np.empty((0, num_bond_features), dtype=np.int32)
        end
        return x, edge_index, edge_attr
    end

    function get_graph_features(edge_attr, edge_index, x)
        atom_feat_sizes = [128, 16, 16, 16, 16, 16, 16, 16, 16]
        edge_feat_sizes = [16, 16, 16]
        N = size(x, 1)
        atom_feat = convert_to_single_emb(x, atom_feat_sizes)
        
        adj = zeros(Int32, N, N)
        adj[edge_index[1, :].+1, edge_index[2, :].+1] .= 1
        degree = sum(adj, dims=2)
        
        if ndims(edge_attr) == 1
            edge_attr = edge_attr[:, nothing]
        end
        edge_feat = zeros(Int32, N, N, size(edge_attr, 2))
        edge_feat[edge_index[1, :].+1, edge_index[2, :].+1, :] = convert_to_single_emb(edge_attr, edge_feat_sizes) .+ 1
        
        shortest_path_result = floyd_warshall(adj)
        spatial_pos = PyTorch.from_numpy(shortest_path_result).long()
        
        feat = Dict()
        feat["atom_feat"] = PyTorch.from_numpy(atom_feat).long()
        feat["atom_mask"] = PyTorch.ones(N).long()
        feat["edge_feat"] = PyTorch.from_numpy(edge_feat).long() .+ 1
        feat["shortest_path"] = spatial_pos .+ 1
        feat["degree"] = PyTorch.from_numpy(degree).long().view(-1) .+ 1
        
        atoms = feat["atom_feat"][.., 1]
        pair_type = cat(
            atoms.view(-1, 1, 1).expand(-1, N, -1),
            atoms.view(1, -1, 1).expand(N, -1, -1),
            dims=-1
        )
        feat["pair_type"] = convert_to_single_emb(pair_type, [128, 128])
        feat["attn_bias"] = PyTorch.zeros((N + 1, N + 1), dtype=torch.float32)
        return feat
    end
    
    function smi2_graph_features(smiles_string)
        mol = Chem.MolFromSmiles(smiles_string)
        mol = AllChem.AddHs(mol, addCoords=true)
        atoms = [atom.GetSymbol() for atom in mol.GetAtoms() if atom.GetSymbol() != "H"]
        mol = AllChem.RemoveHs(mol)
        x, edge_index, edge_attr = get_graph(mol)
        feat = get_graph_features(edge_attr, edge_index, x)
        feat["atoms_token"] = atoms
        return feat
    end


    mutable struct MoleculeFeatureDataset <: AbstractBaseWrapperDataset
        dataset
        smi_key::String
        drop_feat_prob::Float64
        seed
        epoch
    end

    function MoleculeFeatureDataset(dataset; smi_key="smi", drop_feat_prob=0.5, seed=nothing)
        instance = MoleculeFeatureDataset(dataset, smi_key, drop_feat_prob, seed, nothing)
        set_epoch!(instance, nothing)
        return instance
    end

    function set_epoch!(self::MoleculeFeatureDataset, epoch; unused...)
        self.epoch = epoch
    end

    @memoize function __cached_item__(self::MoleculeFeatureDataset, idx::Int, epoch)
        py_idx = idx - 1
        data = self.dataset[py_idx]
        mol = Chem.MolFromSmiles(data[self.smi_key])
        mol = AllChem.AddHs(mol, addCoords=true)
        atoms_h = np.array([atom.GetSymbol() for atom in mol.GetAtoms()])
        atoms = np.array([atom.GetSymbol() for atom in mol.GetAtoms() if atom.GetSymbol() != "H"])

        if self.drop_feat_prob <= 0.0
            @assert all(data["atoms"] .== atoms_h) (data["atoms"], atoms_h)
        end
        mol = AllChem.RemoveAllHs(mol)
        x, edge_index, edge_attr = get_graph(mol)

        data_copy = copy(data)
        data_copy["atoms"] = np.array(data["atoms"])
        data_copy["node_attr"] = x
        data_copy["edge_index"] = edge_index
        data_copy["edge_attr"] = edge_attr
        data_copy["atoms_h_token"] = atoms_h
        data_copy["atoms_token"] = atoms

        numpy_seed(self.seed, epoch, py_idx) do
            data_copy["drop_feat"] = rand() < self.drop_feat_prob
        end
        
        return data_copy
    end
    
    Base.getindex(self::MoleculeFeatureDataset, index::Int) = __cached_item__(self, index, self.epoch)
    
    function pad_1d(samples, pad_len; pad_value=0)
        batch_size = length(samples)
        tensor = PyTorch.full((batch_size, pad_len), pad_value, dtype=samples[1].dtype)
        for i in 1:batch_size
            tensor[i, 1:size(samples[i], 1)] = samples[i]
        end
        return tensor
    end

    function pad_1d_feat(samples, pad_len; pad_value=0)
        batch_size = length(samples)
        @assert ndims(samples[1]) == 2
        feat_size = size(samples[1], -1)
        tensor = PyTorch.full((batch_size, pad_len, feat_size), pad_value, dtype=samples[1].dtype)
        for i in 1:batch_size
            tensor[i, 1:size(samples[i], 1), :] = samples[i]
        end
        return tensor
    end

    function pad_2d(samples, pad_len; pad_value=0)
        batch_size = length(samples)
        tensor = PyTorch.full((batch_size, pad_len, pad_len), pad_value, dtype=samples[1].dtype)
        for i in 1:batch_size
            tensor[i, 1:size(samples[i], 1), 1:size(samples[i], 2)] = samples[i]
        end
        return tensor
    end

    function pad_2d_feat(samples, pad_len; pad_value=0)
        batch_size = length(samples)
        @assert ndims(samples[1]) == 3
        feat_size = size(samples[1], -1)
        tensor = PyTorch.full((batch_size, pad_len, pad_len, feat_size), pad_value, dtype=samples[1].dtype)
        for i in 1:batch_size
            tensor[i, 1:size(samples[i], 1), 1:size(samples[i], 2), :] = samples[i]
        end
        return tensor
    end

    function pad_attn_bias(samples, pad_len)
        batch_size = length(samples)
        pad_len += 1
        tensor = PyTorch.full((batch_size, pad_len, pad_len), float("-inf"), dtype=samples[1].dtype)
        for i in 1:batch_size
            tensor[i, 1:size(samples[i], 1), 1:size(samples[i], 2)] = samples[i]
            tensor[i, size(samples[i], 1)+1:end, 1:size(samples[i], 2)] .= 0
        end
        return tensor
    end
end

    using PyCall

    const np = pyimport("numpy")
    const Dictionary = pyimport("unicore.data").Dictionary
    
    export AttnBiasDataset, PadBiasDataset2D, NoisePointsDataset

    mutable struct PadBiasDataset2D <: AbstractBaseWrapperDataset
        dataset
        pad_idx
        left_pad
    end
    
    function PadBiasDataset2D(dataset, pad_idx; left_pad=false)
        return PadBiasDataset2D(dataset, pad_idx, left_pad)
    end
    
    function collater(self::PadBiasDataset2D, samples)
        function collate_tokens_2d(values, pad_idx; pad_to_length=nothing, pad_to_multiple=1)
            size_val = maximum(v.size(0) for v in values)
            size_val = pad_to_length === nothing ? size_val : max(size_val, pad_to_length)
            if pad_to_multiple != 1 && size_val % pad_to_multiple != 0
                size_val = Int(((size_val - 0.1) ÷ pad_to_multiple + 1) * pad_to_multiple)
            end
            res = values[1].new(length(values), size_val, size_val).fill_(pad_idx)
            for i in 1:length(values)
                res[i, 1:size(values[i], 1), 1:size(values[i], 2)] = values[i]
                res[i, size(values[i], 1)+1:end, 1:size(values[i], 2)] .= 0
            end
            return res
        end
        return collate_tokens_2d(samples, self.pad_idx, pad_to_multiple=8)
    end
    
    mutable struct NoisePointsDataset <: AbstractBaseWrapperDataset
        dataset
        coord_dataset
        vocab
        pad_idx::Int
        mask_idx::Int
        noise_type::String
        noise::Float64
        seed::Int
        mask_prob::Float64
        mask_token_prob::Float64
        leave_unmasked_prob::Float64
        random_token_prob::Float64
        has_bos::Bool
        has_eos::Bool
        weights
        epoch
        noise_f
    end

    function NoisePointsDataset(dataset, coord_dataset, vocab, pad_idx, mask_idx, noise_type; noise=1.0, seed=1, mask_prob=0.15, mask_token_prob=0.15, leave_unmasked_prob=0.1, random_token_prob=0.1, has_bos=true, has_eos=true)
        @assert 0.0 < mask_prob <= 1.0
        @assert 0.0 < mask_token_prob < 1.0
        @assert 0.0 <= random_token_prob <= 1.0
        @assert 0.0 <= leave_unmasked_prob <= 1.0
        @assert random_token_prob + leave_unmasked_prob <= 1.0
        
        weights = nothing
        if random_token_prob > 0.0
            weights = np.ones(length(vocab))
            weights[vocab.special_index()] .= 0
            weights = weights / sum(weights)
        end
        
        if noise_type == "trunc_normal"
            noise_f = num_mask -> np.clip(np.random.randn(num_mask, 3) * noise, a_min=-noise * 2.0, a_max=noise * 2.0)
        elseif noise_type == "normal"
            noise_f = num_mask -> np.random.randn(num_mask, 3) * noise
        elseif noise_type == "uniform"
            noise_f = num_mask -> np.random.uniform(low=-noise, high=noise, size=(num_mask, 3))
        else
            noise_f = num_mask -> 0.0
        end

        instance = NoisePointsDataset(dataset, coord_dataset, vocab, pad_idx, mask_idx, noise_type, noise, seed, mask_prob, mask_token_prob, leave_unmasked_prob, random_token_prob, has_bos, has_eos, weights, nothing, noise_f)
        return instance
    end
    
    function set_epoch!(self::NoisePointsDataset, epoch; unused...)
        set_epoch!(self.coord_dataset, epoch)
        set_epoch!(self.dataset, epoch)
        self.epoch = epoch
    end

    Base.getindex(self::NoisePointsDataset, index::Int) = __getitem_cached__(self, self.epoch, index)
    
    @memoize function __getitem_cached__(self::NoisePointsDataset, epoch::Int, index::Int)
        py_index = index-1
        ret = Dict()
        numpy_seed(self.seed, epoch, py_index) do
            item = self.dataset[py_index]
            coord = self.coord_dataset[py_index]
            sz = length(item)
            @assert sz > 0
            
            num_mask_token = Int(floor(self.mask_token_prob * sz + rand()))
            mask_idc = sample(1:sz, num_mask_token, replace=false)
            mask_token = falses(sz)
            mask_token[mask_idc] .= true
            
            ret["targets"] = fill(self.pad_idx, length(mask_token))
            ret["targets"][mask_token] = item[mask_token]
            ret["targets"] = PyTorch.from_numpy(ret["targets"]).long()
            
            rand_or_unmask_prob = self.random_token_prob + self.leave_unmasked_prob
            unmask, rand_mask = nothing, nothing
            if rand_or_unmask_prob > 0.0
                rand_or_unmask = mask_token .& (rand(sz) .< rand_or_unmask_prob)
                if self.random_token_prob == 0.0
                    unmask = rand_or_unmask
                elseif self.leave_unmasked_prob == 0.0
                    rand_mask = rand_or_unmask
                else
                    unmask_prob = self.leave_unmasked_prob / rand_or_unmask_prob
                    decision = rand(sz) .< unmask_prob
                    unmask = rand_or_unmask .& decision
                    rand_mask = rand_or_unmask .& .!decision
                end
            end
            
            if unmask !== nothing
                mask_token = mask_token .⊻ unmask
            end
            new_item = copy(item)
            new_item[mask_token] .= self.mask_idx
            if rand_mask !== nothing
                num_rand = sum(rand_mask)
                if num_rand > 0
                    new_item[rand_mask] = np.random.choice(length(self.vocab), num_rand, p=self.weights)
                end
            end
            ret["atoms"] = PyTorch.from_numpy(new_item).long()
            
            num_mask = Int(floor(self.mask_prob * sz + rand()))
            mask_idc = sample(1:sz, num_mask, replace=false)
            mask = falses(sz)
            mask[mask_idc] .= true
            ret["mask_cord"] = PyTorch.from_numpy(mask)
            new_coord = copy(coord)
            new_coord[mask, :] .+= self.noise_f(num_mask)
            ret["coordinates"] = PyTorch.from_numpy(new_coord).float()
            
            if self.has_bos
                sz += 1
            end
            if self.has_eos
                sz += 1
            end
            ret["attn_bias"] = PyTorch.zeros((sz, sz), dtype=torch.float32)
        end
        return ret
    end

end

module Unimol2DataNormalizeDataset
    using PyCall

    mutable struct NormalizeDataset <: AbstractBaseWrapperDataset
        dataset
        coordinates

        epoch
    end
    
    function NormalizeDataset(dataset, coordinates, coordinates_2d; normalize_coord=true)
        instance = NormalizeDataset(dataset, coordinates, coordinates_2d, normalize_coord, nothing)
        set_epoch!(instance, nothing)
        return instance
    end
    
    function set_epoch!(self::NormalizeDataset, epoch; unused...)
        self.epoch = epoch
    end

    @memoize function __cached_item__(self::NormalizeDataset, index::Int, epoch)
        py_index = index - 1
        dd = copy(self.dataset[py_index])
        coordinates = dd[self.coordinates]
        coordinates_2d = dd[self.coordinates_2d]
        
        if self.normalize_coord
            coordinates = coordinates .- mean(coordinates, dims=1)
            dd[self.coordinates] = coordinates.astype(np.float32)
            dd[self.coordinates_2d] = coordinates_2d .- mean(coordinates_2d, dims=1)
        end
        
        return dd
    end

    Base.getindex(self::NormalizeDataset, index::Int) = __cached_item__(self, index, self.epoch)

    mutable struct NormalizeDockingPoseDataset <: AbstractBaseWrapperDataset
        dataset
        coordinates
        pocket_coordinates
        center_coordinates
        epoch
    end
    
    function NormalizeDockingPoseDataset(dataset, coordinates, pocket_coordinates; center_coordinates="center_coordinates")
        instance = NormalizeDockingPoseDataset(dataset, coordinates, pocket_coordinates, center_coordinates, nothing)
        set_epoch!(instance, nothing)
        return instance
    end

    function set_epoch!(self::NormalizeDockingPoseDataset, epoch; unused...)
        self.epoch = epoch
    end

    @memoize function __cached_item__(self::NormalizeDockingPoseDataset, index::Int, epoch)
        py_index = index - 1
        dd = copy(self.dataset[py_index])
        coordinates = dd[self.coordinates]
        pocket_coordinates = dd[self.pocket_coordinates]
        
        center_coordinates = mean(pocket_coordinates, dims=1)
        coordinates = coordinates .- center_coordinates
        pocket_coordinates = pocket_coordinates .- center_coordinates
        
        dd[self.coordinates] = coordinates.astype(np.float32)
        dd[self.pocket_coordinates] = pocket_coordinates.astype(np.float32)
        dd[self.center_coordinates] = center_coordinates.astype(np.float32)
        
        return dd
    end
    
    Base.getindex(self::NormalizeDockingPoseDataset, index::Int) = __cached_item__(self, index, self.epoch)
end

    export get_graph_features, kabsch_rotation, get_optimal_transform, Unimol2FeatureDataset, collater, floyd_warshall, pad_1d, pad_1d_feat, pad_2d, pad_2d_feat, pad_attn_bias, Unimol2FinetuneFeatureDataset

    @njit function floyd_warshall(M)
        (nrows, ncols) = size(M)
        @assert nrows == ncols
        n = nrows
        
        for i in 1:n, j in 1:n
            if M[i, j] == 0
                M[i, j] = 509
            end
        end
        for i in 1:n
            M[i, i] = 0
        end
        for k in 1:n, i in 1:n, j in 1:n
            cost_ikkj = M[i, k] + M[k, j]
            if M[i, j] > cost_ikkj
                M[i, j] = cost_ikkj
            end
        end
        for i in 1:n, j in 1:n
            if M[i, j] >= 509
                M[i, j] = 509
            end
        end
        return M
    end

    function get_graph_features(edge_attr, edge_index, node_attr, drop_feat)
        atom_feat_sizes = [16 for _ in 1:8]
        edge_feat_sizes = [16, 16, 16]
        x = node_attr
        N = size(x, 1)

        atom_feat = convert_to_single_emb(x[:, 2:end], atom_feat_sizes)
        
        adj = zeros(Int32, N, N)
        adj[edge_index[1, :].+1, edge_index[2, :].+1] .= 1
        degree = sum(adj, dims=2)
        
        if ndims(edge_attr) == 1
            edge_attr = edge_attr[:, nothing]
        end
        edge_feat = zeros(Int32, N, N, size(edge_attr, -1))
        edge_feat[edge_index[1, :].+1, edge_index[2, :].+1, :] = convert_to_single_emb(edge_attr, edge_feat_sizes) .+ 1
        
        shortest_path_result = floyd_warshall(adj)
        
        if drop_feat
            atom_feat .= 1
            edge_feat .= 1
            degree .= 1
            shortest_path_result .= 511
        else
            atom_feat .+= 2
            edge_feat .+= 2
            degree .+= 2
            shortest_path_result .+= 1
        end

        feat = Dict()
        feat["atom_feat"] = PyTorch.from_numpy(atom_feat).long()
        feat["atom_mask"] = PyTorch.ones(N).long()
        feat["edge_feat"] = PyTorch.from_numpy(edge_feat).long()
        feat["shortest_path"] = PyTorch.from_numpy(shortest_path_result).long()
        feat["degree"] = PyTorch.from_numpy(degree).long().view(-1)

        atoms = feat["atom_feat"][.., 1]
        pair_type = cat(
            atoms.view(-1, 1, 1).expand(-1, N, -1),
            atoms.view(1, -1, 1).expand(N, -1, -1),
            dims=-1
        )
        feat["pair_type"] = convert_to_single_emb(pair_type, [128, 128])
        feat["attn_bias"] = PyTorch.zeros((N + 1, N + 1), dtype=torch.float32)
        return feat
    end
    
    function kabsch_rotation(P, Q)
        C = P.T * Q
        V, _, W = svd(C)
        d = (det(V) * det(W.T)) < 0.0
        if d
            V[:, end] = -V[:, end]
        end
        U = V * W
        return U
    end

    function get_optimal_transform(src_atoms, tgt_atoms)
        src_center = mean(src_atoms, dims=1)
        tgt_center = mean(tgt_atoms, dims=1)
        r = kabsch_rotation(src_atoms .- src_center, tgt_atoms .- tgt_center)
        x = tgt_center - src_center * r
        return r, x
    end
    
    mutable struct Unimol2FeatureDataset <: AbstractBaseWrapperDataset
        smi_dataset
        token_dataset
        src_pos_dataset
        src_2d_pos_dataset
        use_2d_pos::Float64
        pad_idx::Int
        mask_idx::Int
        mask_token_prob::Float64

    function Unimol2FeatureDataset(smi_dataset, token_dataset, src_pos_dataset, src_2d_pos_dataset, pad_idx, mask_idx; mask_token_prob=0.15, mask_pos_prob=1.0, noise=1.0, noise_type="uniform", drop_feat_prob=1.0, use_2d_pos=0.5, seed=1)
        if noise_type == "trunc_normal"
            noise_f = num_mask -> np.clip(randn(num_mask, 3) * noise, a_min=-noise * 2.0, a_max=noise * 2.0)
        elseif noise_type == "normal"
            noise_f = num_mask -> randn(num_mask, 3) * noise
        elseif noise_type == "uniform"
            noise_f = num_mask -> (rand(Float64, (num_mask, 3)) .* 2 .- 1) .* noise
        else
            noise_f = num_mask -> 0.0
        end
        instance = Unimol2FeatureDataset(smi_dataset, token_dataset, src_pos_dataset, src_2d_pos_dataset, use_2d_pos, pad_idx, mask_idx, mask_token_prob, noise, noise_type, mask_pos_prob, drop_feat_prob, seed, nothing, noise_f)
        set_epoch!(instance, nothing)
        return instance
    end
    
    function set_epoch!(self::Unimol2FeatureDataset, epoch; unused...)
        self.epoch = epoch
    end
    
    Base.getindex(self::Unimol2FeatureDataset, idx::Int) = __getitem_cached__(self, self.epoch, idx)

    function get_masked_token(self::Unimol2FeatureDataset, src_token, mask_token_prob)
        sz = length(src_token)
        @assert sz > 0
        num_mask_token = Int(floor(mask_token_prob * sz + rand()))
        mask_idc = sample(1:sz, num_mask_token, replace=false)
        mask_token = falses(sz)
        mask_token[mask_idc] .= true
        target_token = fill(self.pad_idx, length(mask_token))
        target_token[mask_token] = src_token[mask_token]
        new_item = copy(src_token)
        new_item[mask_token] .= self.mask_idx
        return new_item, target_token
    end

    function get_noised_coord(self::Unimol2FeatureDataset, coord, mask_cord_prob)
        sz = size(coord, 1)
        num_mask = Int(floor(mask_cord_prob * sz + rand()))
        mask_idc = sample(1:sz, num_mask, replace=false)
        mask = falses(sz)
        mask[mask_idc] .= true
        new_coord = copy(coord)
        new_coord[mask, :] .+= self.noise_f(num_mask)
        return new_coord, mask
    end

    align_dataset(self::Unimol2FeatureDataset, src_pos, tgt_pos) = src_pos * get_optimal_transform(src_pos, tgt_pos)[1] .+ get_optimal_transform(src_pos, tgt_pos)[2]

    function get_molecule_feat(self::Unimol2FeatureDataset, smiles, drop_feat_prob, epoch, idx)
        data = Dict()
        mol = Chem.MolFromSmiles(smiles)
        mol = AllChem.AddHs(mol, addCoords=true)
        atoms_h = [atom.GetSymbol() for atom in mol.GetAtoms()]
        atoms = [atom.GetSymbol() for atom in mol.GetAtoms() if atom.GetSymbol() != "H"]
        mol = AllChem.RemoveAllHs(mol)
        x, edge_index, edge_attr = get_graph(mol)
        data["node_attr"] = x
        data["edge_index"] = edge_index
        data["edge_attr"] = edge_attr
        data["atoms_h_token"] = atoms_h
        data["atoms_token"] = atoms
        numpy_seed(self.seed, epoch, idx) do
            data["drop_feat"] = rand() < drop_feat_prob
        end
        return data
    end
    
    @memoize function __getitem_cached__(self::Unimol2FeatureDataset, epoch::Int, idx::Int)
        py_idx = idx - 1
        ret = Dict()
        numpy_seed(self.seed, epoch, py_idx) do
            src_token = self.token_dataset[py_idx]
            src_token_mask, target_token = get_masked_token(self, src_token, self.mask_token_prob)
            ret["src_token"] = PyTorch.from_numpy(src_token_mask).long()
            ret["target_token"] = PyTorch.from_numpy(target_token).long()
            
            molecule_feat = get_molecule_feat(self, self.smi_dataset[py_idx], self.drop_feat_prob, epoch, py_idx)
            feat = get_graph_features(molecule_feat["edge_attr"], molecule_feat["edge_index"], molecule_feat["node_attr"], molecule_feat["drop_feat"])
            
            src_pos, tgt_pos = if !molecule_feat["drop_feat"] && rand() < self.use_2d_pos
                (self.src_2d_pos_dataset[py_idx], self.src_2d_pos_dataset[py_idx])
            else
                (self.src_pos_dataset[py_idx], self.src_pos_dataset[py_idx])
            end
            
            masked_pos, mask_coord_index = get_noised_coord(self, src_pos, self.mask_pos_prob)
            masked_pos = align_dataset(self, masked_pos, tgt_pos)
            
            ret["src_pos"] = PyTorch.from_numpy(masked_pos).float()
            ret["target_pos"] = PyTorch.from_numpy(tgt_pos).float()
            ret["src_mask_cord"] = PyTorch.from_numpy(mask_coord_index).bool()
            
            merge!(ret, feat)
        end
        return ret
    end

    function collater(self::Unimol2FeatureDataset, items)
        pad_fns = Dict(
            "src_token" => pad_1d, "target_token" => pad_1d, "src_pos" => pad_1d_feat, "target_pos" => pad_1d_feat,
            "src_mask_cord" => pad_1d, "atom_feat" => pad_1d_feat, "atom_mask" => pad_1d, "edge_feat" => pad_2d_feat,
            "shortest_path" => pad_2d, "degree" => pad_1d, "pair_type" => pad_2d_feat, "attn_bias" => pad_attn_bias
        )
        max_node_num = maximum(item["atom_mask"].shape[1] for item in items)
        max_node_num = (max_node_num + 1 + 3) ÷ 4 * 4 - 1
        
        batched_data = Dict()
        for key in keys(items[1])
            if haskey(pad_fns, key)
                samples = [item[key] for item in items]
                batched_data[key] = pad_fns[key](samples, max_node_num)
            end
        end
        return batched_data
    end

module Unimol2Infer
    using PyCall
    using Logging
    using PyTorch

    const pickle = pyimport("pickle")
    const os = pyimport("os")
    const sys = pyimport("sys")
    const checkpoint_utils = pyimport("unicore.checkpoint_utils")
    const distributed_utils = pyimport("unicore.distributed_utils")
    const options = pyimport("unicore.options")
    const utils = pyimport("unicore.utils")
    const progress_bar = pyimport("unicore.logging.progress_bar")
    const tasks = pyimport("unicore.tasks")

    export main, cli_main
    
    Logging.basicConfig(format="%(asctime)s | %(levelname)s | %(name)s | %(message)s",
                        datefmt="%Y-%m-%d %H:%M:%S",
                        level=get(ENV, "LOGLEVEL", "INFO"),
                        stream=sys.stdout)
    const logger = Logging.getLogger("unimol.inference")

    function main(args)
        @assert args.batch_size !== nothing "Must specify batch size either with --batch-size"
        use_fp16 = args.fp16
        use_cuda = PyTorch.cuda.is_available() && !args.cpu
        
        if use_cuda
            PyTorch.cuda.set_device(args.device_id)
        end
        
        data_parallel_world_size, data_parallel_rank = if args.distributed_world_size > 1
            (distributed_utils.get_data_parallel_world_size(), distributed_utils.get_data_parallel_rank())
        else
            (1, 0)
        end

        logger.info("loading model(s) from $(args.path)")
        state = checkpoint_utils.load_checkpoint_to_cpu(args.path)
        task = tasks.setup_task(args)
        model = task.build_model(args)
        model.load_state_dict(state["model"], strict=false)

        if use_fp16
            model.half()
        end
        if use_cuda
            model.cuda()
        end

        logger.info(args)
        loss = task.build_loss(args)
        loss.eval()

        for subset in split(args.valid_subset, ",")
            try
                task.load_dataset(subset, combine=false, epoch=1)
                dataset = task.dataset(subset)
            catch e
                if e isa KeyError
                    throw(ErrorException("Cannot find dataset: " + subset))
                else
                    rethrow()
                end
            end

            if !os.path.exists(args.results_path)
                mkpath(args.results_path)
            end
            fname = split(args.path, "/")[end-1]
            save_path = os.path.join(args.results_path, fname * "_" * subset * ".out.pkl")

            itr = task.get_batch_iterator(
                dataset=dataset,
                batch_size=args.batch_size,
                ignore_invalid_inputs=true,
                required_batch_size_multiple=args.required_batch_size_multiple,
                seed=args.seed,
                num_shards=data_parallel_world_size,
                shard_id=data_parallel_rank,
                num_workers=args.num_workers,
                data_buffer_size=args.data_buffer_size,
            ).next_epoch_itr(shuffle=false)
            
            progress = progress_bar.progress_bar(
                itr,
                log_format=args.log_format,
                log_interval=args.log_interval,
                prefix="valid on '$(subset)' subset",
                default_log_format=(!args.no_progress_bar ? "tqdm" : "simple"),
            )
            
            log_outputs = []
            for (i, sample) in enumerate(progress)
                sample = use_cuda ? utils.move_to_cuda(sample) : sample
                if isempty(sample)
                    continue
                end
                _, _, log_output = task.valid_step(sample, model, loss, test=true)
                progress.log(Dict(), step=i)
                push!(log_outputs, log_output)
            end
            
            open(save_path, "wb") do f
                pickle.dump(log_outputs, f)
            end
        end
        logger.info("Done inference! ")
    end
    
    function cli_main()
        parser = options.get_validation_parser()
        options.add_model_args(parser)
        args = options.parse_args_and_arch(parser)
        distributed_utils.call_main(args, main)
    end
end
